stem.text: A large excess of marble chips was reacted with $25\ \text{cm}^{3}$ of $1.0\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid at 40 °C.
How will the result be different when the reaction is repeated with $60\ \text{cm}^{3}$ of $0.5\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid at 40 °C?

A.text: The reaction is faster and less of the products are made.

B.text: The reaction is faster and more of the products are made.

C.text: The reaction is slower and less of the products are made.

D.text: The reaction is slower and more of the products are made.
